model_output.verdict: A youth workforce program manager with a clear progression and a team, but few details about the students served.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story: you moved from tutoring at City Year Baltimore to coordinating and then managing youth workforce programs at Harbor Pathways. A recruiter can see the work you own, but not yet how many students or employers the program reaches.

The line about supervising 4 program coordinators and 20 seasonal staff gives a recruiter a concrete picture of your management responsibility. Your current role also names grant reports and Salesforce, so the work is easy to follow. What’s missing is more about the program those staff support and what you track.

Let’s start with the summer jobs line. Add the number of students placed and employers involved if you have those figures, then give the same treatment to partner recruitment and the career fair. Keep the grant reporting line: it already names a concrete deliverable and its audience.
